jd_text:
一，拥有20年的资管行业经验。公司股东为华泰证券、Heron View Partners LLC和苏州高新，注册资本人民币2亿元，总部位于上海，下设北京分公司。
公司在指数、量化、固收、权益等多个领域树立标杆，致力提供高质量的资产配置工具以及全方位的财富解决方案。成立至今，凭借出色的整体业绩表现与风控管理能力，共获得金牛奖35座。

二、在招社招/ 校招岗位

FOF研究员—上海（1名）

【工作职责】
1、负责FOF的定量研究、量化模型的搭建，开发FOF策略，撰写研究报告；
2、参加基金经理调研，整理纪要；
3、参与维护公募基金分析体系，包括基金评价、基金库、绩效评估及业绩归因等；
4、为FOF投资、基金投顾、基金销售等业务提供研究支持；
5、对AI及大模型有研究经验；
6、协助领导完成其他相关工作。
【任职要求】
1、具有较强的数理背景，国内外重点大学硕士及以上学历，金融工程、统计学、数学、计算机等相关背景；
2、扎实的数据分析能力，熟练使用Python、Matlab等编程语言和sql数据库等优先考虑，具备AI Coding的能力；
3、对于各类资产有深入研究，熟悉量化策略、大类资产配置策略、衍生品策略等优先考虑；
4、具有1~3年相关经验；
5、具有基金从业资格者优先。

指数研究员—上海（3名）

【工作职责】
1、支持部门产品和指数的研究； 
2、部门产品营销材料制作以及竞品分析；
3、支持营销销售路演工作。【任职要求】
1、硕士学历，经济类、金融、金融工程、统计相关专业，具备金融、统计相关的知识储备；
2、具有基金从业资格优先，具有三年以上相关工作经验，具备一定行业研究和策略研究经历优先；
3、沟通和表达能力强，工作有激情，具有亲和力、英语书面和口语水平良好。

信用研究员—上海（2名）

【工作职责】
1、对城投、产业或金融等行业及发债主体进行信用研究，搭建及维护内部评级模型，撰写内部信用研究报告；
2、维护内部信用债券库，对在库及持仓标的及时进行跟踪和调研，捕捉投资机会或提示风险；
3、开展信用及资产策略研究，负责相关行业趋势、利差跟踪、资产定价等研究工作，为部门决策提供支持，挖掘投资机会。

【任职要求】
1、硕士研究生及以上学历；
2、从事信用研究工作4年以上；
3、数理统计能力强，擅长搭建数据库及固收量化策略，具备python，SQL 等编程语言熟练应用能力者优先考虑。

资金交易员—上海（1名）

【工作职责】
1、精准执行交易指令：根据基金经理或投资经理的指令，及时、准确完成各类交易操作。运用市场判断能力，尽量争取最好的交易价格完成交易。
2、实时监控与异常处理：严密监控交易执行过程中的市场波动、指令异常或系统故障，第一时间向投资团队反馈，防范交易差错与潜在风险。
3、交易后支持与报告：完成交易簿记、结算对账、合同归档、数据报送等工作，撰写市场分析简报、统计交易数据，为投研提供数据支持。
4、系统与流程优化：参与交易系统测试、交易制度建设与流程改进，推动自动化与智能化工具的应用，提升交易效率与合规性。
5、跨部门协同：与风控、运营、合规、投资等部门保持高效沟通，确保交易全流程符合监管要求与公司内控标准。

【任职要求】
1、硕士研究生及以上学历；
2、经济、金融、数学、统计等相关专业；
3、三年以下工作经验，特别优秀的26届毕业生亦可；
4、有基金从业资格者优先。

机构业务产品经理—上海（1名）

【工作职责】
1、负责机构业务日常资料整理、文书编撰、信息汇总复盘、业务跟踪、研究支持等事项；
2、协助完成AI工具在金融工作场景的落地应用、流程优化；
3、配合机构业务团队完成日常沟通对接、事务统筹及各类辅助性工作。

【任职要求】
1、硕士研究生及以上学历；
2、三年以内工作经验，特别优秀的26届毕业生亦可；
3、具备一定AI相关知识储备，拥有AI工具实操经验、AI相关项目实践、课程学习、技能研究者均可；
4、具备金融基础知识体系，有基金、证券、资管、金融中台、金融服务等金融行业学习、实习或从业经验优先，熟悉金融基础业务逻辑者优先。

【工作职责】
1、搭建AI运营体系，推动AI工具在短视频、图片、直播制作流程中的应用，推动内外部AI内容（稿件、活动）产出，搭建并维护AI知识库；

4、与IT部门紧密合作，将AI能力嵌入现有业务流程与系统，优化用户体验与工作效率；
5、领导交办的其他事项等。

【任职要求】
1、硕士研究生及以上学历，1年及以上AI运营、项目管理、内容运营相关工作经验；
2、对AI有浓厚兴趣，熟悉主流AIGC、AI Agent工具，了解工具底层逻辑与落地场景；
3、具备AI项目管理或运营经验，能独立推进多线程任务，确保进度与质量；
4、有较强的数据分析能力，熟练使用Python、SQL、Java等工具；熟悉至少一种BI工具：Power BI/Fine BI/Tableau等，可独立交付可视化看板；

6、具备基金从业资格优先。

1、协助研究国内外资管行业及产品发展动态；
2、协助整理市场数据；
3、协助公募产品材料修改工作；

ASSET & WEALTH MANAGEMENT 

Bringing together traditional and alternative investments, we provide clients around the world with a dedicated partnership and focus on long-term performance. As the firm’s primary investment area, we provide investment and advisory services for some of the world’s leading pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, financial advisors and individuals, for which we oversee more than $2 trillion in assets under supervision. Working in a culture that values integrity and transparency, you will be part of a diverse team that is passionate about our craft, our clients, and building sustainable success. We are:

Investors, spanning traditional and alternative markets offering products and services
Advisors, understanding our clients’ priorities and poised to help provide investment advice and strategies that make sense for their portfolios
Thought Leaders, providing timely insights across macro and secular themes to help inform our clients’ investment decisions
Innovators, using our suite of digital solutions to help our clients address complex challenges and meet their financial goals 

Our teams are involved in various investment opportunities encompassing corporate equity, growth equity, infrastructure, impact funds etc.  Our Private Equity team seeks long-term capital appreciation by committing equity to high quality companies with strong management.

Our team have a strong competitive advantage through the following:

Access to sophisticated financial advice in public and private market financing, mergers, acquisitions, trading, foreign exchange, commodities and investment and economic research
A worldwide network in sourcing, structuring and operating successful business ventures
A creative approach to identifying attractive investments by leveraging the scale of our committed capital, sponsorship and experience

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be involved in all stages of the deal lifecycle. Examples of responsibilities include:

Meeting and liaising with target company management teams and founders 
Developing investment theses 
Researching and assessing domestic & global markets 
Building financial investment models
Coordinating w/ offshore GS domain experts, 3rd party diligence advisors, and investment banks 
Presenting in investment committee 
Participating in deal structuring and investment documentation 
Managing and monitoring portfolio companies post investment
Supporting portfolio companies in strategic and operational projects including M&A, capital raising, asset sales, and budgeting 

Qualifications

Highly motivated team player to be integrally involved in all aspects of private equity investing. The ideal candidate has passion & curiosity about investing, as well as strong accounting/finance and business assessment skills.

Other criteria include: 

1-3 years investment banking, and/or private equity investing experience 
Team player with positive attitude and strong work ethic 
Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
Demonstrated proactiveness and ability to adapt quickly to a variety of industries  
Excellent communication skills, both written and oral 
Strong technical skills in financial analysis, research, financial model building
Strong ability to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment 
Ability to self-direct, analyze and evaluate and form independent judgments
Ability to effectively interact and build relationships with senior management and global stakeholders 
Commercially savvy with ability to exercise discretion with respect to highly confidential/sensitive information
Integrity, ethical standards and sound judgment
Close attention to detail 
Excellent English and Mandarin

The continued growth and success of BNP Paribas in  Hong Kong depends on attracting the people we need to see it through – we believe that the key to our development is in enabling yours.

OUR PROGRAMMES

THE APAC GRADUATE TWO-YEAR PROGRAMME

Our comprehensive two-year APAC Graduate Programme is designed to give final year bachelor’s or master’s degree students and recent graduates the support and development needed to launch a successful career in the banking and finance industry.

You could join us in one of our business areas or support functions and assume real responsibility from day one.

THE APAC INTERNSHIP PROGRAMME

If you are a full-time student in your penultimate year or someone who has just graduated, we can offer you a chance to learn more about BNP Paribas through a six-month internship experience running from January to June in Hong Kong or Singapore. You’ll learn on the job, attend insightful events, join product and soft skills training, and experience professional networking gatherings. Do well, and you can expect to be considered for conversion to a full-time role when you graduate.

ANALYST STREAM

Apply as a recent graduate, final year undergraduate, or master’s student

No professional work experience post qualification is required

You should have a GPA of 3.3/4 or above (or equivalent) in any discipline

You will need to be fluent in spoken and written English

DEVELOPMENT

LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT

To enhance your knowledge, we will take you along a tailored development path to build your expertise and broaden your skills through the various learning channels (classroom, virtual and on-demand e-learning) offered by our Regional Learning & Development team. As a learning company, the opportunities at BNP Paribas are endless.

ON THE JOB TRAINING

You will receive business specific training to help you familiarise yourself with our different products, services and operations that your team manages. You will also have the support and guidance from your line manager and the team to build expertise, thrive in your role and contribute towards the Bank’s continued success.

EVALUATIONS AND CHECK-INS

To support your growth and progression within the Bank, there will be regular touchpoints for you to review and discuss your development needs and career direction.

OPPORTUNITIES

ROTATIONS

To provide graduates with maximum exposure during the two-year programme, most graduates will have the opportunity to complete at least one rotation across or outside of your hiring team.

REGIONAL PROJECTS

To stretch and challenge you, participation in a regional project provides an opportunity for you to work with other APAC Graduates under the guidance of the project sponsor. This project will give you a broader perspective and exposure to what BNP Paribas does across the region, and provides you with further opportunities to establish strong internal connections beyond your immediate team.

CAREER PROGRESSION

As a permanent hire, upon completion of the two-year programme, you will be ready to take on the challenges in the next phase of your career with the Bank.

EXPOSURE

INDUCTION

To orientate you to our culture and equip you with key skills to succeed in your role, the programme starts with two weeks of training where you will participate in combined group induction courses where you will learn more about BNP Paribas and acquire both cross-functional, regional and technical skills through engaging learning sessions tailored just for you.

MENTORSHIP

Supported by dedicated colleagues, (both mentors and early career professionals), you will also be enrolled in a formal mentoring journey that is complemented by resources that allow you to make the most out of the mentorship.

NETWORKING

To help you grow your connections within the bank, networking events are designed to provide you with the opportunity to meet and interact with colleagues from other territories, and engage with our senior leaders.

We’ll support you to succeed in every way, helping you understand what your future might look like and giving you the tools you need to achieve your goals.

 Induction
 Barclays is a rich, diverse, complex organisation with so much to offer. We want you to be equipped to navigate our business and get as much as you can from it. So, the focused training sessions in your induction programme are designed to give you the core knowledge and skills you’ll need to get off to the very best start. We're creating a vibrant global community that connects people across the business. It’s a chance for you to network, take ownership, gain insight and get inspired. Most of all, it’s a way to connect with your entire graduate cohort and support each other as you grow your careers.

 Programme-aligned Learning Labs
